answer.explanation: Customer is a domain entity in the ordering context, and it imports the TypeORM `Entity` decorator at line 2. That ties the domain model to a persistence framework. FF-DT04 flags this because domain code should stay free of infrastructure and framework packages. The project documents this case on purpose. The comment at Customer.ts:1 and the register in docs/architecture-exceptions.md:7 both accept the TypeORM decorator on Customer as a legacy mapping, active until 2027-03-31. Today is 2026-10-22, so the exception is still current. It stays in force until the persistence split moves the mapping to infrastructure.
